_doc: Skate School with Karl the Fog (src/client/school.ts, client only): the tutorial, taught in order in the park (parks: the worlds it is played in). Each lesson: spot (a spot id or alias, or 'x y z heading') it starts at (teleport), setup (more commands at its start), boost (Karl's gust: the first push after the lesson starts sets this speed, m/s), reset (a failed try puts you back at the spot resetSeconds later), Karl's line (say), the keys (keys: rows of actions from data/controls.json, shown with the player's keyboard keys, rebinds included, and the pad's buttons; '+' and 'then' are words between them), a hint after hintTries failed tries or hintSeconds without it, his line when it is done (done), and its check, from the sim's events: steps, each an event (t) with fields at least (min) or at most (max) a number, equal to one of (is), a trick of a kind (tricks: flips, grabs or specials, for trickEnd), or a combo holding entries of each kind (has: grind, manual, special, for comboLanded), in order; ride: rolling at speed m/s having turned turn degrees; walk: walking that many metres after the steps. A bail starts the steps over and is a failed try; in an air lesson so is coming down from a pop or a ramp without it done (judged landGraceSeconds after the landing, so a revert counts). doneSeconds: Karl's done line shows that long before the next lesson. prompt: the one-time question on the very first launch. graduate: the sticker event sent at the end (data/stickers.json), its art, and the card pointing on to the Tour and the game modes.

prompt.title: New here?
prompt.line: Skate School takes 2 minutes. Karl the Fog teaches. He is a cloud, but he means well.

graduate.title: Graduated
graduate.line: Karl is proud. Karl is also just weather. Next: the city's challenges, a set in every neighbourhood, or the Game modes: Hill Bomb, S.K.A.T.E., Courier, Combo Challenge.

lessons.title: Push and steer
lessons.say: Welcome to Skate School. I'm Karl. I'm a cloud. Push to roll, lean to steer. Try not to hit a tourist.
lessons.hint: Hold push for a couple of seconds, then lean while you roll.
lessons.done: Look at you, rolling. Your mom would cry.

lessons.title: Ollie
lessons.say: Roll, hold to crouch, let go to pop. Hold longer, go higher. Like rent.
lessons.hint: Hold it a moment before you let go. Quick taps make tiny ollies.
lessons.done: Air! Brief. Like summer in SF.

lessons.title: Flip trick
lessons.say: Pop, then flip with a direction. The board spins. You don't.
lessons.hint: Press flip with a direction right after the pop, while you're still going up.

lessons.title: Grab
lessons.say: Big 3. Push hard, pop at the top, grab with a direction and hold on. Like it's the last parking spot.
lessons.hint: Push all the way down the run-up, pop right at the top of the stairs, then hold grab.
lessons.done: Grabbed it. Nobody saw you sweat.

lessons.title: Grind
lessons.say: See the ledge ahead? Push, ollie onto it, and hit grind as you come down on it. Lean to stay on.
lessons.hint: Push for two seconds, pop just before the ledge, and press grind while you're over it.

lessons.title: Manual
lessons.say: Roll up to the manual pad and tap up, then down. You're on the back wheels. Up and down keep you level.
lessons.hint: Get rolling, then tap up and down quickly, one after the other.

lessons.title: Link a combo
lessons.say: Now link them: grind the ledge, manual the second you land, then ollie out. The points multiply. Like condos.
lessons.hint: The moment you land off the ledge, tap up then down. Then pop out of the manual to bank it.
lessons.done: That's a combo. You're a professional now. Unpaid.

lessons.title: Revert
lessons.say: Push and I'll blow you up the quarter. I'm wind, technically. Grab in the air, then hit revert the moment you land.
lessons.hint: Ride straight up, hold grab in the air, and press revert right as your wheels touch.
lessons.done: Smooth. Like fog through the Golden Gate.

lessons.title: Special trick
lessons.say: I topped up your special meter. Don't tell anyone. Land a kickflip to fill it, then off Big 3: two directions and flip.
lessons.hint: Kickflip on the run-up, then pop off Big 3 and press right, down and flip in the air.

lessons.title: Powerslide
lessons.say: Going too fast? Hold powerslide, the board swings sideways, and you stop. Brakes are for robotaxis.
lessons.hint: Get rolling fast first, then hold powerslide all the way to a stop.

lessons.title: Step off and walk
lessons.say: Step off and walk. Some places you just stroll. Step off again to drop the board and roll.
lessons.hint: Press step off, then walk a few steps.
